$schema.description: This schema. Saving from Settings, setup or the command line pins it to the tag of the StableBar version that saved the file, which tells an older version that the file was written for a newer one.

anyOf.description: User mapping of AeroSpace mode names to semantic mode.<alias> states. Themes cannot set this mapping.

includes.description: Files to compose before this one, relative to this file.

popupDefaults.description: Styles every popup inherits. A popup's own style and its widget's style win; defaults fill the rest.

widgetOverrides.description: Properties merged into widgets by ID.

screens.description: Theme, colors, styles, bar settings and layout for the laptop screen, landscape monitors or vertical monitors.

profile.description: Name of the only profile to apply, or null for automatic matching.

packageSources.description: Private package catalogs listed beside the StableBar Store. Tokens are kept in the Keychain, never here.

theme.description: Theme applied after widget packages and before includes. Without version, a theme that ships with StableBar; with version, an installed theme package.

color.description: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, or {"light": …, "dark": …} for a color that follows the light or dark appearance.

angle.description: Degrees clockwise from towards the top, as in CSS: 90 (the default) runs left to right, 180 top to bottom.

locations.description: Where each color sits, from 0 to 1 in ascending order, one per color. Evenly spaced by default.

background.description: A color, or {"gradient": {"colors": […], "angle": …, "locations": […]}} for a linear gradient.

anyOf.description: Screens matching any of these kinds.

glass.description: Experimental. Draws the widget, popup and bar backgrounds as native Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later, tinted with their colors.

enabled.description: Turns Liquid Glass on. Off by default.

transparency.description: How much glass shows through the background colors: 0 keeps the colors, 1 is pure glass. 0.3 by default.

widgets.description: Glass for widgets that have a background. On by default.

popups.description: Glass for popups that have a background. On by default.

bar.description: Glass for the bar when it has a background. On by default.

placement.description: Workspace indicatorStyle only: cell preserves cell-relative drawing; belowBar starts at the visible bar bottom plus offsetY.

borderEdges.description: Only bar.style and script barStyle consume this property. Bottom preserves the default; all draws an inset outline.

flare.description: Only group styles consume flare: the group's top corners curve outward past its sides with this radius, and cornerRadius rounds only its bottom corners. 0 keeps the top corners square.

symbolVariant.description: The SF Symbols variant to draw symbols in, such as fill, slash or circle.fill: slash, then at most one shape, then fill, as SF Symbols names them. A symbol without it keeps its own look; none draws symbols as named.

style.description: Widget style. Unset values inherit from defaults.

states.description: Styles applied after base layers: data state, workspace state, mode, mode.<alias>, hover, then open. Groups do not consume states.

transition.description: How changed text and symbols appear: none, fade, roll or numeric.

app.description: The bundle ID or name of the app whose menu bar items this names.

item.description: The Accessibility identifier or title of one of the app's items. Without it, every item of the app.

icon.description: An SF Symbol a shown item draws in place of its icon.

display.description: How a shown item draws: "icon", its app's icon (the default), or "live", a copy of the item as macOS draws it in the menu bar, which needs macOS 27 or later and Screen Recording access. A live item that macOS isn't drawing shows its icon.

value.description: What the slider sends as VALUE on the end stop, and the value of its source that puts the knob there.

label.description: Drawn under the end stop and read by VoiceOver, such as ∞.

orientation.description: The direction of a list's entries. Defaults to vertical.

open.description: An http, https, mailto or x-apple.systempreferences URL, or an application bundle identifier.

transition.description: For text, field and symbol blocks; defaults to the widget's.

endStop.description: For sliders: one more stop past max, set apart by a notch, such as ∞. Its value must be outside min…max.

filled.description: For sliders: draw a bar in the block's style instead of macOS's slider. The background is the track, the accent fills it, and clicking or dragging anywhere sets the value. An endStop sits past a notch at the end and fills the whole bar.

icon.description: For filled sliders: an SF Symbol drawn on the fill at its leading end, in accentText.

autofocus.description: For input blocks: put the cursor in the field when the popup opens.

sendButton.description: For input blocks: a round button in the field that sends its text. The block's style draws the field.

busy.description: For input blocks with a send button: a field that, while it isn't empty, turns the send button into a stop button that runs onStop.

wrap.description: For field blocks: show all of the text over as many lines as it needs, selectable. For input blocks: run the text onto more lines as you type.

maxHeight.description: For field blocks that wrap and vertical lists: the height past which they scroll, keeping the newest content in view.

markdown.description: For field blocks: show Markdown, such as bold, italics, code and links, and in a field that wraps also headings, lists, code blocks and tables.

fitWidth.description: In a popup: make the block as wide as its content, up to its maxWidth, and place it by its alignment, as a chat bubble.

shimmer.description: For text and field blocks: sweep light across the text, as while something works.

groupsSource.description: For chooser blocks: a list of groups, whose rows have value, title, icon, detail, option, level and levelsTitle.

optionsSource.description: For chooser blocks: a list of options, whose rows have group, value, title and detail.

levelsSource.description: For chooser blocks: a list of levels, whose rows have group, value and title.

starsSource.description: For chooser blocks: a list of starred presets, whose rows have group, option and level, shown as chips with ⌘1 to ⌘9.

block.description: A layout block for widget layouts, overlays and popups.

pinnable.description: Show a pin button that keeps the popup on screen and lets it be dragged.

onOpen.description: A command to run each time the popup opens, with SENDER=popup.opened.

onClose.description: A command to run each time the popup closes, pinned or not, with SENDER=popup.closed.

hideApps.description: App bundle IDs or app names to leave out, matched like appGlyphs keys.

hideWorkspaces.description: Workspace names to leave out unless focused.

badges.description: Marks each app icon whose app has a Dock badge: a dot, or the badge's count or text. Off when omitted.

details.description: Show the built-in details popup for Clock, Battery, System monitor, Network or Calendar. Custom popups and click actions take precedence.

hideWhenIdle.description: For a privacy widget, show only the microphone or camera while it is in use, and hide the widget while neither is.

timeZone.description: Clock time zone identifier. Omit to follow the Mac.

template.description: Name of a template in templates.

tooltip.description: Hover text. Overrides the script tooltip; an empty string hides it.

background.description: Background of the bar widget only, overriding style.background.

popupBackground.description: Background of this widget's popups, overriding the popup's style.

tooltipBackground.description: Background of this widget's tooltips and hover controls.

open.description: An http, https, mailto or x-apple.systempreferences URL, or an application bundle identifier.

expandOnHover.description: Show only the app name until hovered in appMenu widgets. Off by default.

click.description: What clicking an appleMenu widget does: open the Apple menu (the default, which needs Accessibility access), open System Settings or lock the Mac.

openOnHover.description: Open the list of menu bar items when the pointer rests on menuBarItems widgets; false opens it on click. On by default.

shown.description: What a menuBarItems widget shows on the bar, in this order: menu bar items instead of in its row, and "symbol", the widget's own symbol, which opens the row. Without "symbol" here or in hidden, the symbol comes last.

hidden.description: Menu bar items a menuBarItems widget leaves out of its row, and "symbol" to leave out its symbol.

interval.description: Seconds between script runs, or null to run only on events.

hoverLayout.description: Extra blocks revealed beside the widget on hover. Sliders stay open while dragging.

transition.description: How the text and symbols of the widget's blocks change, and how the widget appears and disappears when its output hides it.

rules.description: Data states from script or provider output. The first matching rule sets the state.

state.description: Data state to set, such as warning, critical, active or muted. Mode and interaction/workspace state names are reserved.

value.description: Name of a number in the output's values.

field.description: Name of a string in the output's fields.

below.description: Matches a value at or below this number.

above.description: Matches a value at or above this number.

equals.description: Matches a field with exactly this text.

sortBy.description: Sort the system provider apps list.

cpuWarning.description: System warning threshold from 0 to 1; above 1 disables this threshold.

memoryWarning.description: System warning threshold from 0 to 1; above 1 disables this threshold.

interval.description: Seconds between updates for command, system and network providers, and for calendar until it has access; for stream, audio and battery, the first retry delay after a failure, which is at least 1 second.

displayScale.description: Retired: scale factors for the bar on each display type, still applied to files that set them. Use screens to size the bar on one kind of screen.

position.description: The edge of each display the bar sits on: top by default, or bottom. At the bottom, popups open upward, notch positions sit as on a display without a notch, and belowMenuBar has no effect.

offset.description: Moves the bar away from its edge, in points: from the top edge, or from the bottom of the menu bar with belowMenuBar, which only applies to a top bar. At the bottom, it counts up from the display's bottom edge.

belowMenuBar.description: Starts the bar under each display's macOS menu bar instead of at the top edge. A display whose menu bar hides keeps the bar at its top edge. Disabled by default.

margin.description: Insets the bar's background and widgets on every side, in points.

keepWindowsClear.description: Move ordinary windows below the bar using Accessibility access. Disabled by default.

keepNotificationsClear.description: Move notification banners below the bar using Accessibility access on macOS 26 or later. Disabled by default.

menuBarRevealDelay.description: Milliseconds to hold at the top edge before revealing the hidden macOS menu bar. Requires Accessibility access. 0 adds no delay.

hideMenuBar.description: Keep the macOS menu bar invisible while StableBar runs, even at the top edge. Quitting StableBar shows it again. Disabled by default.

hoverDelay.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests on a widget before its tooltip, hover controls or hover popup opens. While one is open, moving to another widget opens its own at once. Defaults to 400.

motion.description: How widgets, popups and changing text animate where they set no animation or transition of their own. Defaults to smooth.

popupTransition.description: How popups open and close. Omit to use the motion's.

morphPopups.description: When a popup or tooltip opens while another is open on the same bar, move and reshape the open one into the new one instead of closing it. Enabled by default.

inlineHoverControls.description: Show hover controls, such as the Sound widget's volume slider, inside the widget, which widens and moves its neighbors, instead of in a tooltip under it. Disabled by default.

animationDuration.description: Seconds that widget and layout animations last. Omit to use the motion's.

fillNotch.description: Paint the notch black behind the widgets, so screen shares and screenshots, which leave the notch out, show the bar as the display does. Disabled by default.

appearance.description: Shows the bar and its popups in the light or dark appearance. Omit to follow the system.

app.description: Bundle identifier of the focused app.

bar.description: Bar settings that replace the shared ones on this kind of screen.

layout.description: Widget IDs by position, in order. Unlisted widgets follow in their own position.

theme.description: Theme for this kind of screen instead of the shared one.

tokens.description: Token values for this kind of screen, merged over the shared ones.

defaults.description: Widget styles for this kind of screen, merged over the shared defaults.

popupDefaults.description: Popup styles for this kind of screen, merged over the shared popupDefaults.

roles.description: Presentation role styles for this kind of screen, merged over the shared ones.

workspaceDefaults.description: Workspace look for this kind of screen, merged over the shared one.

modeAliases.description: AeroSpace mode names for this kind of screen, merged over the shared ones.
